# M64/60 piston with cooling gallery, CP1 F0 concept

**Status: **prohibited pending engineering**. No part is released; see [SAFETY.md](../../SAFETY.md).**

Independent concept of an Aheadd CP1 LPBF piston with a toroidal gallery under the crown and two temporary depowdering ports. Only the M64/60 bore/stroke/engine speed and the Porsche methodological precedent are published; the entire piston geometry remains an F0 hypothesis.

Catalogue record: [`catalog/parts/993-eng-piston-cp1-gallery-f0-0001.json`](../../catalog/parts/993-eng-piston-cp1-gallery-f0-0001.json)

| post-processing | controlled removal of all powder through two opposed temporary ports, 400 °C treatment for 4 h per the published route, to be requalified on the part, HIP to be decided after analysis of defects, fatigue and the gallery, port closure by a qualified process, then proof test and CT of the gallery, machining of the diameter, skirt, ring grooves, pin bores and datum faces, finishing, anti-friction coating, pin/ring matching and set balancing |
